unverified.reason: The run-log entry C6 places in flightdeck/launch/RUNLOG.md is written by fc launch end, which runs only after review and green evidence; a check requiring the entry would hold the run red before it could end. Unverifiable by design; the human reads it at gate 3. The other parts of C6 are T32.

C4 states facts about Claude Code itself (the hook envelope and blocking events, agent file format, the workflow runtime, sessions not scriptable from outside). A check on the suite cannot prove a property of Claude Code; only a live session could, and C8 forbids any suite from starting one. The suite relies on these facts; it does not prove them.
